buddies.name: Eagle Descent Stage
buddies.voice_line: Hi! I'm Eddie! I stayed behind so my friends could fly home!
buddies.story_60sec: Hello! I'm Eddie. I am the legs of Apollo 11. I carried Neil and Buzz down to the Moon in 1969. It was dusty and grey! My job was to stay still and be strong. When my friends went home, they used me like a launch pad. Boom! They flew up. I stayed. I am still there today. Quiet and proud.
buddies.discovery_simple: People can land and take off from the Moon

quiz.question: What did Eddie do?
options: Stayed still to hold the lander and launch friends home

buddies.name: Apollo 17 Moon Buggy
buddies.story_60sec: Hey! I'm Bouncy! I'm a Moon car. I fold up like a chair! Astronauts unfolded me in 1972. I had no doors and no roads. Just bouncy grey dust! We drove far to find pretty rocks. We found orange soil! That told us the Moon once had hot volcanoes. I am parked now. My cameras look down at my wheels.

quiz.question: What cool soil did Bouncy find?

buddies.name: ALSEP Science Station
buddies.voice_line: Shhh... I am listening to the Moon...
buddies.story_60sec: Shhh. I'm Lizzie. I have big ears. I listen for Moonquakes! Astronauts left me in 1971. I felt tiny shakes. I also have a mirror. Scientists shine lasers at me from Earth. The light bounces back! That tells us how far the Moon is. I was turned off in 1977. But my mirror still says hello!
buddies.discovery_simple: Moon shakes and we can measure its distance

quiz.question: How does Lizzie still help?
options: Her mirror bounces lasers from Earth

buddies.name: Surveyor 3
buddies.voice_line: I waited and my friends came to visit!
buddies.story_60sec: Hi! I'm Sid. I landed in 1967. No humans with me! Just me, a robot. My job was to touch the soil. Was it soft like snow? Would we sink? No! It was strong! That meant astronauts could come. Two years later, Apollo 12 landed nearby. They walked over and said hi! They took my camera home.

quiz.question: Why was Sid important?
options: He proved astronauts would not sink

buddies.name: Sojourner
buddies.voice_line: Small but mighty! I went first!
buddies.story_60sec: Hi! I'm Sojourner. I'm tiny! Like a skateboard! In 1997 I became the first rover on Mars. I rolled off my lander. Bump, bump over red rocks! I sniffed rocks with my science nose. I found round pebbles. Pebbles mean water once pushed them! I showed tiny rovers can do big work.

buddies.name: Spirit
buddies.story_60sec: Hello! I'm Spirit! I landed in 2004. I was supposed to live 90 days. I lived 6 years! I climbed hills with my six wheels. I got stuck in soft sand. Oh no! But I kept working from that spot. I found white silica. That means hot water was once here! I fell asleep in the cold winter of 2010.
buddies.discovery_simple: Mars was once warm and wet

buddies.name: Opportunity
buddies.voice_line: Hi! I was supposed to live 90 days but lived 15 YEARS!
buddies.story_60sec: Hi! I'm Oppy! Spirit is my twin sister! I landed in 2004. I loved to drive! I drove 45 kilometers. That is a whole marathon! My cameras saw rocks that only grow in water. So Mars was soggy long ago! Every year I sang Happy Birthday to myself. In 2018 a giant dust storm covered my sun panels. I fell asleep. My last message was: My battery is low.

buddies.name: Viking 1
buddies.voice_line: Say cheese! First photo from Mars!
buddies.story_60sec: Hello! I'm Vicky! I landed in 1976. I was the first to live on Mars! Click! I took the very first photo FROM Mars. Red rocks and pink sky! I had an arm to scoop soil. I tasted it for tiny life. We did not find life, but we learned a lot. I worked 6 years! Now I sleep in Chryse Planitia.
buddies.discovery_simple: First Mars photos and soil tests

buddies.name: Viking 2
buddies.story_60sec: Hi! I'm Vinnie! Vicky is my twin! I landed far north in 1976. It was very cold. I had a weather station. I felt wind and cold days. One morning I saw white frost! Frost on Mars! Like winter! I watched seasons change. I fell asleep in 1980. Cold but happy.

buddies.name: Phoenix
buddies.voice_line: Yum! Let me taste that soil!
buddies.story_60sec: Hello! I'm Phoenix! I landed near the North Pole in 2008. Cold! I have a robot arm. Dig, dig! I scooped white ice. Real water ice! I put it in my tiny ovens to taste it. I saw snow fall from the sky! Snow on Mars! Winter came and I got too cold. I sleep under ice now.

buddies.name: InSight
buddies.voice_line: Shhh... Did you feel that rumble?
buddies.story_60sec: Shhh. I'm Innie. I landed in 2018. I don't drive. I listen! I put my ear on the ground. I felt Mars shake! Rumble! I felt over 1300 Marsquakes! That told us Mars has a big liquid heart inside. Dust covered my sun panels. I fell asleep in 2022. Listen carefully. Can you feel it?

quiz.question: How many Marsquakes did Innie feel?

buddies.name: Ingenuity
buddies.story_60sec: Wheee! I'm Ginny! I'm a tiny helicopter! In 2021 I flew on Mars! The air is super thin. My blades had to spin super fast! First flight: up, hover, down! Everyone cheered! I flew 72 times! I helped my friend rover find paths. On my last flight my blade broke. I rest now. First flyer on another world!

quiz.question: How many times did Ginny fly?

buddies.name: NEAR Shoemaker
buddies.story_60sec: Hello! I'm Narly. I visit asteroids! In 2001 I landed softly on Eros. Eros is a space rock! I took many photos. Eros is a pile of rubble. Not solid! That helps us protect Earth. I was not supposed to land, but I did it! Surprise! I still hug Eros as we drift around the Sun.

buddies.name: Dawn
buddies.story_60sec: Hi! I'm Dawny! I love road trips! I visited TWO worlds: Vesta then Ceres. No one else did that! I have an ion engine. It sips fuel like a straw! I saw a giant mountain and salty ice volcanoes on Ceres. In 2018 I ran out of fuel. I orbit Ceres forever. Silent and proud.

quiz.question: How many worlds did Dawny visit?

buddies.name: Pioneer 10
buddies.voice_line: I carry a postcard for aliens!
buddies.story_60sec: Hello! I'm Pip! I launched in 1972. I was first to cross the asteroid belt. Scary rocks! I made it! Then I said hi to Jupiter! Click! Big photos! Now I drift far away. I carry a golden plaque. It has pictures of humans. If aliens find me, they will say hello! Bye bye!

buddies.name: Pioneer 11
buddies.story_60sec: Hi! I'm Pippa! Pip is my big brother! I launched in 1973. I visited Jupiter too. Then I flew farther! I was the FIRST to visit Saturn! Wow! Rings everywhere! I used planets like a slingshot to fling forward. Now I drift toward the stars. Far, far away.

quiz.question: What was Pippa first to visit?

buddies.name: Kepler
buddies.story_60sec: Hello! I'm Keppy! I count stars! From 2009 to 2018 I stared at stars. Blink! When a planet passes, the star gets a tiny bit dim. I count the blinks! I found over 2600 planets!Planets are everywhere! Some might be like Earth! I ran out of fuel. I drift now. Keep looking up!

quiz.question: How does Keppy find planets?
options: Sees tiny blinks when planets pass stars
